scenes.title: A tap fills a tank
scenes.problem: A tap fills a tank: The empty tank gains 2 litres each minute. Sketch the graph with minutes horizontally and litres vertically. Explain the change on each interval and whether the plotted marks should be joined.
actions: Label the horizontal axis minutes and vertical axis litres. Start at (0, 0), because the story begins with 0 litres.
Plot (1, 2) and show the first interval 0 to 1: litres increases by 2.
Keep that interval visible; plot (2, 4). From 1 to 2, litres increases by 2.
Plot (3, 6). On the last interval litres increases by 2. The final point is (3, 6); connect only across meaningful inputs. Check each point against the story.
scenes.memo: The empty tank gains 2 litres each minute. The graph values are (0, 0), (1, 2), (2, 4), (3, 6). The final point is (3, 6); connect only across meaningful inputs. Therefore (0, 0) → (1, 2) → (2, 4) → (3, 6); connected graph.

scenes.repair: Project each endpoint to the minutes and litres axes; compare consecutive outputs and check whether intermediate inputs are meaningful.
